title: TheRoaringShield
body:
TheRoaringShield Mod adds one item and one boss to Minecraft. When holding The Roaring Shield and right-clicking, a short animation and fun sound effect play, granting the player a powerful buff. The Roaring Skeleton awaits as a challenge.
Also, still on beta right now! so all the stuff that the mod added, it's only available to creative mode.
